build_sonar_text_embeddings: build a SonarTextBatchEmbedder to convert text columns into Sonar embeddings using a Fairseq2 pipeline
create_embedding_decoder: create a SonarEmbeddingToTextMapper to decode Sonar embeddings back into text for a target language
configure_multilingual_embedding: configure a LangColumnConfig with a lang_column for multilingual text embedding across multiple languages
run_partitioned_embedding_job: run a SonarTextEmbedderStopes module to process partitioned Parquet data into Sonar text embeddings
review_embedding_config: review the SonarTextEmbedderConfig to verify model_name, batch_size, and dtype settings for embedding generation
